homeAbout.title: I moved into software from hospitality and stayed for the mix of craft, systems thinking, and product problem solving.
paragraphs: I build product-facing features with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Node.js, and SQL, and I am increasingly working with TanStack Query and structured form flows where they improve reliability and developer experience.

As the team grows, I also expect to take on more QA ownership. My hands-on QA work today is focused on API testing with Postman and Swagger-documented Next.js endpoints, validating behavior, edge cases, and frontend-backend alignment.

about.title: What I bring beyond the landing page.
paragraphs: I moved into software after years in hospitality and found the kind of work I want to keep doing: solving problems, improving systems, and building interfaces that feel clear, reliable, and useful.

My core focus is frontend engineering with React and TypeScript, but I work comfortably across the stack when that helps ship a better product. That includes stateful UI, API integration, TanStack Query data flows, and structured form work.

As the product and team evolve, I also expect to take on more QA responsibility. My practical QA experience today is centered on API testing with Postman and Swagger-documented Next.js endpoints, where I focus on validating behavior, edge cases, and frontend-backend alignment.
